title: euonymus × pseudoradicans
intro: Euonymus × pseudoradicans, commonly known as Spindle, is a hybrid plant species in the Euonymus genus. Research suggests that it has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Euonymus × pseudoradicans are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, although specific studies are limited. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential benefits and actions of this plant species.
